description: OMENZ Checkpoint (submit): deliver one milestone. Its acceptance tests run; you get PASS/FAIL and the escrow verdict for THAT tranche: RELEASE (buyer pays it now), RETRY (seller fixes, max 3 attempts) or REFUND (failed or late, not owed), a signed receipt, and running totals (released / refunded / pending). A decided milestone can't be passed or counted twice. Seller track record updated. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/checkpoint/submit, $0.01 via x402.)
